issues.description: The function fix_fix2float has inconsistent return types across repositories: in the example_program header it is declared to return float, while in the tests header it is defined to return double. This mismatch of the same function name/signature across project parts can confuse students about the intended type and may cause subtle linking/type issues when using the function across translation units.
issues.suggestedFix: Pick a single return type for fix_fix2float (either float or double) and make it consistent across both example_program and tests. Update the declaration in example_program/src/math_fix.h and the implementation (example_program/src/math_fix.c) or update tests/src/math_fix.h so both declare/define fix_fix2float with the same return type. Prefer using double if higher precision is desired, or float if API intends single-precision, and document the choice.
